option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and skin biopsy findings are consistent with Acral Peeling Skin Syndrome, which is a rare genetic disorder characterized by peeling skin, particularly on the hands and feet.
Peeling skin disease (PSD) is a broader term that encompasses various conditions characterized by peeling skin, including Acral Peeling Skin Syndrome.
Peeling skin syndrome is a general term that refers to a group of conditions characterized by peeling skin, including Acral Peeling Skin Syndrome.
Peeling Skin Syndrome Type B (Acral) is another term for Acral Peeling Skin Syndrome, which is a rare genetic disorder characterized by peeling skin, particularly on the hands and feet.
